review_candidates.title: Financial Data Analyst
review_candidates.description: Company Description Matrix Consulting is a contemporary financial consulting firm focused on comprehensive fundraising support for businesses across multiple industries, including Retail, Energy, Pharma, Agro, Shipping, Media, Entertainment, Automobile, Manufacturing, Trading, Hospital, IT, and Real Estate. The firm primarily serves Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and large corporate institutions that drive economic growth and employment. Matrix Consulting works with a diverse range of promoters, from startups to second-generation entrepreneurs, helping them address challenges in expansion and organizational structuring. An internal Chartered Accountancy (CA) firm strengthens the company’s ability to deliver end-to-end financial services. The firm specializes in crafting tailored financial models and strategies, covering the full spectrum of fundraising from Private Equity and Debt procurement to exit strategies such as IPOs. Role Description The Financial Data Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning, and analyzing financial and operational data to support fundraising, capital structuring, and strategic decision-making for clients. Day-to-day activities include building and maintaining financial models, performing variance and trend analysis, preparing data-driven reports and dashboards, and supporting due diligence for debt and equity transactions. The analyst will collaborate with consultants, finance professionals, and the internal CA team to interpret data, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights. The role also involves presenting findings to internal stakeholders, contributing to client presentations, and continuously improving data processes and methodologies. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and a demonstrated ability to interpret complex financial and business data. Candidates should possess Data Analytics and Data Analysis skills for handling large datasets, creating reports, and building dashboards. Candidates should possess Financial Analysis and Finance skills, including understanding of financial statements, ratios, valuation, and capital markets. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. Proficiency in spreadsheets and data tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau) and strong attention to detail. Effective communication skills, ability to present insights clearly, and capacity to work collaboratively in a consulting environment. Prior experience in financial services, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance is an advantage. Professional certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM, CA, or relevant data analytics certifications) are beneficial. Location: Hyderabad Working Days: Monday to Saturday Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Employment Type: Full-Time

review_candidates.title: Enterprise Account Executive – North Asia
review_candidates.description: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview Magnet Forensics is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to grow our private-sector business across North Asia. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important market and play a central role in expanding Magnet Forensics’ enterprise presence across Japan and North Asia. This role will focus on Japan as the primary market and have additional responsibility for South Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong. The successful candidate will build pipeline, acquire new enterprise customers and expand strategic existing accounts. We are looking for a senior cybersecurity salesperson with strong relationships across the Japanese enterprise market, particularly with CISOs, SOC leaders and incident response teams. They will own complex sales cycles from initial engagement through to close, working with customers, partners, marketing and sales engineering. What You’ll Do Develop and execute a territory plan, with a clear focus on expanding Magnet Forensics’ presence in Japan. Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive relationships, industry networking, marketing activities and partner engagement. Acquire strategic new enterprise customers and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts. Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, including discovery, technical evaluation, commercial negotiation and close. Apply MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities, build champions, engage economic buyers and maintain accurate forecasts. Develop trusted relationships with CISOs, SOC leaders, incident response teams and corporate security stakeholders. Work with distributors, resellers and systems integrators to develop and progress partner-led opportunities. Represent Magnet Forensics at customer meetings, industry events and partner activities across the region. Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity and forecasting information in Salesforce. What We’re Looking For At least seven years of enterprise cybersecurity sales experience. Proven success selling software or technology solutions into enterprise SOC, incident response or corporate security teams. Strong existing relationships within the Japanese enterprise and cybersecurity market. A track record of winning new logos, building pipeline and achieving revenue targets. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles. Strong knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology. Experience working across both direct and partner-led sales models. Strong commercial, negotiation and executive communication skills. Fluent Japanese and English, both written and spoken. Willing to travel regularly across Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong. Travel will be required 30%-50% of the time. Self-motivated and able to independently develop a territory. Commercially focused, organised and disciplined in pipeline management. Credible with both executive and technical stakeholders. Comfortable working across different cultures, markets and time zones. Proactive, accountable and motivated by long-term market development. Nice To Have Skills Experience selling Digital Forensics, Incident Response, investigative or threat intelligence technology. Existing enterprise or partner relationships in South Korea, Taiwan or Hong Kong. Knowledge of regional cybersecurity and data protection requirements. Korean or Mandarin language skills. Formal MEDDPICC training. Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact [email protected] should you require any accommodations. All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment. US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here . Magnet does not use artificial intelligence (defined as a machine-based system that infers from input to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions) for screening, assessing, or selecting applicants. Should this practice change, we will update this disclosure accordingly.

Oversight of all contract activities, both maintenance and projects and ensure all safety aspects are managed and monitored in accordance with site procedures and requirements. Drive and deliver innovative cost reduction or sustainability programs Support the team with the preparation of budget documentation from an engineering delivery perspective as required for client approvals. Cross regional support associated with staff during peak workloads and/or holiday and sickness cover for the engineering senior management team. Staff supervision including all full-time, part-time, sub-contractors and specialist providers. Be proactive and provide technical guidance in relation to preventative maintenance and extra works delivery. Comply with all procedures and maintain clear & legible records as required. Actively participate in emergency out of hour escalations and provide written incident reports as required. Develop and sign off detailed planning of the IST Testing activities in conjunction with the local team. Attendance at these events to ensure cohesive delivery. Co-ordination of test windows with the internal clients to include documentation control and management – Service Now In support of the critical environments manager and engineering teams to ensure the following critical activities are up to date and achieved as required. Playbook Procedures implemented and validated as required. Advise any operational risks are up to date and notified to the regional team. Critical Asset tracker updates to ensure these are replaced before they cause critical failures. Annual Plant Condition Assessment Critical Spares Inventory PPM Plan in line with client Critical Site Infrastructure(CSI) matrix Oversight of Change Requests – Required for all works on services which may impact critical works. Fire Systems testing and recording. Close all actions assigned from audits and assurance visits, gap plan produced and tracked. Obtaining Results Through People – supports, challenges, and develops others so that they can give their best and deliver against expectations. Teamwork – manages the team to maximise their contributions and effectiveness, influencing personal commitments. Communication – communicates clearly and concisely, impressing others and ensuring understanding of all relevant information in all circumstances. Planning, Organising & Executing – pre-plan, organises and schedules activities and resources, monitoring the execution against timescales and plans. review_candidates.description: La Compagnie des Signaux renforce ses équipes et recrute un Concepteur Systèmes de Signalisation Bord H/F en CDI, pour son site des Ulis (91) – siège social. A propos de nous : La Compagnie des Signaux (CSEE) est l’un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine de la digitalisation et de l’automatisation des systèmes de signalisation ferroviaire. En France, toutes les lignes à Grande Vitesse sont équipées par CSEE de systèmes de signalisation, à la fois le long de voies et à bord des trains. Ces dispositifs permettent d’assurer un intervalle le plus court possible entre les trains circulants à une vitesse commerciale de 320km/h, tout en garantissant un niveau maximal de sécurité. CSEE connait actuellement une forte dynamique de croissance aussi bien en France qu’à l’international avec l’objectif de doubler son volume d’activité sur les cinq prochaines années. Sur 2025 de grands contrats ont été signés qui viennent conforter cette trajectoire de développement. A l’échelle internationale, de nombreux opérateurs souhaitent créer de nouvelles lignes ferroviaires, notamment dans le secteur de la Grande Vitesse, mais aussi d’augmenter la capacité et la sécurité des infrastructures existantes. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, CSEE conçoit et déploie des solutions innovantes de transport ferroviaire intégrées à haute valeur technologique intégrant des logiciels et calculateurs de sécurité. Notamment au travers des programmes de recherche sur les trains autonomes (sans conducteur) en cours de développement. CSEE fait partie depuis peu du Groupe MERMEC qui est présent dans 21 pays et compte plus de 3 000 employés dans le monde. CSEE a été désigné comme le centre d’excellence du Groupe dans le domaine de la signalisation, lui confiant la responsabilité du développement de cette activité à l’échelle mondiale. La Compagnie des Signaux emploie aujourd'hui plus de 600 personnes réparties sur trois sites en France et trois sites permanents à l’étranger : Les Ulis (Ile-de-France) : siège social, ingénierie, développement et management des projets Riom (Auvergne) : site industriel de production et logistique, ingénierie et développement Paris (Champs Elysées) : équipe de maintenance 24/7 d'une partie des réseaux de métro et de tramway de la RATP 1 filiale : Allemagne (Munich) 3 succursales : Angleterre (Londres), Corée (Séoul) et Maroc (Rabat) En plus de ces sites permanents, la Compagnie des Signaux est présente dans de nombreux projets localisés en France et à l’étranger, et prévoit un fort développement de son activité sur tous les continents. Rejoindre les équipes de la Compagnie des Signaux c’est intégrer un pôle d'excellence et de compétences mondial en matière de technologies ETCS (ERTMS) et automatismes ferroviaires. Grâce à ces compétences uniques, nous façonnons l'avenir des transports ferroviaires à travers le monde. A la Compagnie des Signaux, vous trouverez votre place en contribuant à la construction d’un monde plus durable et connecté. Impliqué(e) dans le cadre de projets internationaux et au sein d’équipes multiculturelles, votre travail sera à la pointe de la transformation numérique et de l’innovation technologique. Le poste que nous vous proposons : En tant que Concepteur Systèmes de Signalisation Bord, vous intervenez au sein de la Compagnie des Signaux, sur le site des Ulis - siège social - en région parisienne (Essonne, 91). Rattaché au Centre de Compétence Bord de la Compagnie des Signaux, vous êtes garant de la spécification correcte de nos équipements bord ferroviaires embarqués dans les trains, sur nos différents projets. Vos principales missions incluent : Participer aux travaux d’études de conception d’un produit bord répondant aux requis client, sous l’égide d’un Spécialiste Signalisation Bord Senior et en privilégiant les solutions déjà existantes Participer à la rédaction des documents d’architecture système permettant la définition de l’équipement de signalisation embarqué (systèmes et/ou sous-systèmes) Participer à la rédaction des documents de définition des exigences fonctionnelles et/ou d’interfaces applicables aux composants du système de signalisation embarqué Systématiser la traçabilité des exigences entre les documents dès lors qu’elle est applicable, afin de faciliter les activités de vérification Participer à l’analyse des écarts et à leur formalisation quant à la conformité du design au regard des requis clients, des normes et référentiels applicables ainsi que des processus de l’entreprise Participer à l’enrichissement d’une base de connaissances et de retour d’expérience où sont dûment enregistrées les erreurs de design détectées, éventuellement les inefficacités des processus et des outils ainsi que, de façon systématique, les actions correctives associées Participer à la rédaction de la fiche de version du système embarqué Modalités de travail : Temps complet Télétravail partiel possible (jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine) Déplacements occasionnels au niveau international Localisation du poste : Au cœur du Parc d’activités de Courtabœuf : 4 avenue du Canada, 91940 Les Ulis Accès facilité : En voiture depuis l’autoroute A10/A11 et la N118 En bus n°4602 depuis la gare RER de Massy Palaiseau (RER B et C) Votre profil : De formation Bac+5, vous êtes diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’université, ou vous possédez des connaissances ou une expérience équivalente. review_candidates.title: Chief People Officer
review_candidates.description: Consider this the people case. Would you back it? We’re looking to a new member of our management team. In this role, you’ll set the direction for People at memoQ and own what comes of it, make the decisions that are genuinely yours to make. You’ll fit right in if you’d rather design an organisation than administer one, and if you’re comfortable making the people case to the management and the CEO. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small HR team while actively contributing to both strategic initiatives and day-to-day HR operations. As HR Manager, you'll work closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape our people’s practices, culture, and employee experience. We're looking for someone who is comfortable moving between strategic discussions and operational challenges, and who isn't afraid to have difficult conversations when important decisions need to be made. And here’s what’s on our side of the table: a seat where the decisions actually get made, a mandate broad enough to be worth taking – strategy, culture, talent, reward and the HR team itself – rather than a title with someone else’s plan attached, and smart people who are willing to contribute to make memoQ a great place to work at. What you’ll do in this position at memoQ The decisions here are yours to make, and yours to defend. In practice, that looks like: Shape the people strategy Define, own, and execute memoQ’s People strategy and annual HR roadmap, aligned with the business strategy. Represent the people perspective in management team decisions, as a strategic partner to the CEO. Lead organizational design, workforce and capability planning, and strategic organizational changes. Own the HR budget and make sure every part of it earns its place. Report to the CEO, the management team and, where required, the board on people metrics, risks, and progress. Own culture and engagement Be the owner of memoQ’s culture and values, making sure they show up in everyday leadership, not just on the wall. Measure and improve engagement and wellbeing, and turn survey and exit insights into actions people actually notice. Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion across the organization. Build talent and leadership Own the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through performance and development to offboarding. Run talent reviews and succession planning for key roles, and build real career paths for high-potential colleagues. Coach and advise the management team on people leadership, and build leadership development programs. Design reward that is fair and transparent Own the compensation and benefits strategy, including job architecture and grading, salary reviews, and market benchmarking. Lead memoQ’s response to the EU Pay Transparency Directive, including pay equity analysis and reporting. Run HR as a modern, compliant function Keep policies and procedures up to date and compliant in Hungary and in the other countries where we employ people, including GDPR for employee data. Drive the digitalization of HR processes and our HRIS, and build people analytics that inform real decisions. Manage employee relations, including close cooperation with our employee representatives. Lead the HR team Lead, develop, and inspire a team of three: an Office Manager & HR Coordinator, a Senior HR Generalist, and an HR Generalist. Raise the bar on HR operations and processes, and give your team room to grow. What we think will help you succeed in this role It’s hard to tick all the boxes. But here is what helps make a difference: 10+ years in HR, with at least 3 of them leading the function as Head of HR, HR Director or similar A real business partnership with a CEO and executives: you’ve been in the room when the hard calls were made, and you helped shape them Organisational design and change you can talk through: what changed, what it cost, and what you would do differently Building, not just running: HR functions and processes you set up from scratch, or rebuilt when they stopped working Depth in talent, performance and reward, including the conversations nobody enjoys having Coaching that leaders actually ask for, and the credibility to challenge them when they need it Integrity and discretion you never have to prove, because people already trust you with what matters Solid grounding in the Hungarian Labour Code, so compliance is a foundation rather than a worry A degree in HR, business, psychology, law or similar is expected, though what you’ve actually done matters more to us Operational experience with HRIS is something you will need in this role, if you know HiBob that is a strong plus Fluent Hungarian and English, since Budapest is our home base and English is our working language We will need a valid certificate of good conduct to comply with strong ethical expectations. The terms on our side of the table You’re evaluating us too. Here’s the pitch: An international team spread across 10 countries, serving clients in 15+ languages A seat on the management team, and a mandate broad enough to be worth taking A flat organisation with no micromanagement, and the autonomy to make your own decisions 2 days/week home office opportunity, on the remining days a nice, cozy office Annual learning budget for courses, certifications, conferences Private health insurance and AYCM access to keep you well, in every sense Annual salary reviews And the one that matters most: actual work-life balance. Doctor’s appointment at 11? Go. Finished everything by 3? Don’t sit there until 5. We hire you for your output, not your hours Why memoQ? Every time a global company launches a product in a new market, someone’s translation technology is doing quiet, load-bearing work behind the scenes. Often, it’s ours. memoQ is a global market leader in translation technology. Our software sits inside the workflows of enterprises, such as ASUS, Hubspot, or DHL. This is memoQ, handling work most people never think about and no product launch can happen without. It’s a niche industry. It’s also an unusually good place to lead people right now. The category is being rewritten by AI while we speak, and the organisation that carries memoQ through that change is still being shaped. We’re big enough that people decisions carry real weight across more countries, and small enough that you won’t spend your first year negotiating with a committee to make one. So this is a leadership job with something actually at stake. You would be deciding what kind of company memoQ becomes for the people in it, not just keeping an HR machine running. How to apply If you think you possess the necessary skills and experience, please apply with your CV, cover letter (in English) to careers@memoq.com. You’ve applied. What’s next? We want all of our candidates to have a smooth and efficient experience with us, which is why we aim to get back to you regarding your application within a short time. As we receive numerous applications for our positions, if your profile corresponds to our requirements to continue the process, we will contact you. Please be aware that we might not be able to reach out to everyone whose profile was not selected. The first step of the selection process is a screening call. This is followed by an online meeting with the hiring manager and relevant stakeholder(s). For C level roles we also run an assessment centre. The final step is a chance to meet your potential teammates.

review_candidates.description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME. Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers. * CFM International est une société commune 50/50 de Safran Aircraft Engines et GE Aerospace. Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi. Au sein de la Direction du Système d'Information de Safran Aircraft Engines composé de 500 collaborateurs, vous intégrerez la division Continuité Numérique. La division Continuité Numérique de Safran Aircraft Engines, c'est participer à un de nos programmes majeurs. Le programme continuité numérique visant à uniformiser les outils du PLM et MES depuis la conception jusqu'à l'après-vente du turbo réacteur, en passant par la fabrication et le montage. Le candidat s'inscrit dans cette démarche et devra, grâce à son expertise, piloter des projets d'implémentation de MES pour notre Direction assurant le MRO de nos moteurs Le chef de projet assume la responsabilité du projet dans toutes ses dimensions (stratégique, financière, humaine, juridique, organisationnelle, technique.). Il est chargé d'atteindre les objectifs de son projet en s'engageant sur les délais, les coûts et la qualité des livrables. Il pilote l'ensemble de celui-ci dans toute sa complexité et notamment l'ensemble des parties prenantes, qu'elles soient fonctionnelles (métiers), techniques, internes ou externes. Il est le garant de l'enjeu stratégique du projet. Il aura notamment pour responsabilité de : - Garantir la pertinence et l'opportunité du développement du projet ainsi que la cohérence avec la roadmap Continuité Numérique. - Porter toutes les décisions importantes ou solliciter l'arbitrage du Comité de pilotage - Présenter régulièrement l'avancement du projet et les plans d'actions associés aux risques - Accompagner les métiers dans l'expression de ses exigences fonctionnelles - Valider la recette définitive du projet - Mener toute action permettant la bonne réalisation du projet - Assurer le respect de toutes les exigences définies en terme de qualité des livrables, performances, coût, délai et sécurité. Ce que Nous Vous Offrons : *Basé à Evry, avec des déplacements possibles sur les sites Safran Aircraft Engines en région parisienne et potentiels sur tous les centres (France et étranger) - Flexibilité avec jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine. - Intégration dans une équipe Système d'Information dynamique et orientée vers la continuité digitale. - Participation à des projets majeurs dans les domaines PDM/PLM/MES, au coeur de la transformation numérique. Diplômé(e)d'un Bac+5 avec une spécialisation en informatique, vous souhaitez mettre à profit votre expérience pour contribuer à l'Industrie 4.0 ? Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience d'au moins 10 ans dans le pilotage de projets informatiques avec une expérience de pilotage de projet M.E.S. Vous faites preuve d'un fort esprit d'équipe et d'adaptabilité pour traiter l'ensemble des sujets de votre périmètre en relation avec l'ensemble des métiers de l'entreprise et l'ensemble des acteurs de la DSI internes /externes.
